view: Frontal chest radiograph, PA projection (L side marker at patient's upper left; left arm abducted/raised)
technical_quality: Adequate. Minimal rotation (medial clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate inspiration (right hemidiaphragm at about the 9th-10th posterior rib), adequate penetration (vertebral bodies faintly visible behind the heart). Large body habitus with prominent bilateral breast shadows overlying both lower zones; left arm raised so axillary/scapular soft tissue overlaps the left upper lateral chest, which slightly limits assessment of the left upper zone. Lung apices and costophrenic angles are included.

devices.type: Surgical clips (three small linear metallic densities, one paired)
devices.location: Right upper zone, medial/infraclavicular region overlying the right 1st-2nd anterior ribs (post-surgical change)
External, image top-right = patient's left shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Large (approx. 6.5 x 8-9 cm) well-defined, homogeneous, dense mass-like opacity in the lateral left mid zone, abutting the lateral chest wall with a convex/lobulated medial margin; aerated lung remains between it and the hilum/mediastinum, ribs pass through it intact - peripheral lung or pleural-based mass (loculated pleural collection less likely)
Elevated left hemidiaphragm relative to the right (dome roughly 2-3 cm higher than the right), suggesting left-sided volume loss or phrenic dysfunction; gastric bubble beneath

Subtle veil-like hazy increased density of the left upper zone compared with the right, with vessels still visible - possible mild volume loss / partial collapse, though overlap of raised-arm soft tissue may contribute

Hazy increased density in the left lower zone with partial obscuration of the lower left heart border and left costophrenic angle; largely attributable to breast shadow overlap, but a small effusion or pleural thickening cannot be excluded
Three surgical clips projected over the right upper zone (medial, infraclavicular) - post-surgical change, e.g. prior lymph node biopsy or thoracic surgery

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA），吸氣尚可、無明顯旋轉，左上臂上舉，雙側乳房軟組織陰影明顯重疊於下肺野。左側中肺野外側可見一約8公分、邊界清楚、密度均勻之腫塊狀陰影，緊貼側胸壁，內側緣呈凸狀，與縱膈之間仍有含氣肺組織；左側橫膈較右側抬高，左上肺野呈輕度薄紗狀霧影，左下肺野亦有霧狀密度增加並部分遮蔽左心緣與左肋膈角（部分為乳房重疊所致）。右上肺野內側可見三枚手術夾（術後變化），右肺其餘清晰、右肋膈角銳利；心臟大小大致正常，氣管居中，主動脈弓稍顯著，骨骼無急性病灶，未見胸管、引流管或其他導管。
